sources.title: Gemma 4 model overview - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Multi-Token Prediction: All Gemma 4 models (E2B, E4B, 12B, 31B, and 26B A4B) include a dedicated draft model for speculative decoding, enabling significantly faster inference with no quality loss. Parameter sizes and quantization Gemma 4 models are available in 5 parameter sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 31B and 26B A4B.
